site.headline:
I ride until
the road runs out.
site.intro: This is the archive — the passes, the punctures, the roadside chai at altitude. Most of these notes were written with the engine still ticking as it cooled.
site.recentNote: I ride slowly and stop often. Most of what's here was shot from the shoulder of a road I had no particular reason to pull over on.

about.headline: I take the long way around.
about.p1: I started carrying a camera because the good parts of a ride are the ones you can't describe afterwards — the ten minutes of light on a pass, the shape of a road you'll never take again. This site is where those frames live, with the notes I made next to them.
about.p2: One bike, one tank bag, one lens. If a shot needed a second lens it probably needed a second ride instead, and that's rarely a problem.
